_: Merge lanes by blast radius (docs/LANES.md). Each file takes the lane of the FIRST rule whose glob matches it; a file no rule matches is yellow, never green. A PR's lane is the highest of its files. Read by tools/agents/lanes.mjs; `**` crosses folders, `*` does not.

green.name: Contained, reversible
green.requires: No agents (D-413). Auto-merge when tests and end-to-end pass.

yellow.name: Wide but reversible
yellow.requires: Usability and documentation agents, scaled by the stage below (D-132, D-304), then auto-merge when tests and end-to-end pass.

red.name: Hard to reverse
red.requires: Never auto-merges, whatever the agents say: the PR gets the needs-owner label, the lane job opens a one-tap decision, and the owner-approval status stays red until the owner ticks it (approve-pr). Agents as for yellow.
